name: Sauce for Plum Pudding (Superior)
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one wine-glass of wine or one of brandy
ingredients.originalText: one wine-glass of wine or one of brandy
ingredients.quantityText: one wine-glass of wine or one of brandy

ingredients.name: one large cupful of hot cream or rich milk
ingredients.originalText: one large cupful of hot cream or rich milk
ingredients.quantityText: one large cupful of hot cream or rich milk

instructions.text: Cream together a cupful of sugar and half a cupful of butter
When light and creamy, add the well-beaten yolks of four eggs
Stir into this one wine-glass of wine or one of brandy, a pinch of salt and one large cupful of hot cream or rich milk
Place it in a saucepan over the fire, stir it until it cooks sufficiently to thicken like cream
Be sure and not let it boil

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cream together a cupful of sugar and half a cupful of butter
2. When light and creamy, add the well-beaten yolks of four eggs
3. Stir into this one wine-glass of wine or one of brandy, a pinch of salt and one large cupful of hot cream or rich milk
4. Beat this mixture well
5. Place it in a saucepan over the fire, stir it until it cooks sufficiently to thicken like cream
6. Be sure and not let it boil
